priorityList: Keep Vampiric Touch and Shadow Word: Pain active on the target.
Cast Halo on cooldown to trigger Archon effects.
Use Power Infusion and Voidform (or Dark Ascension) together as your primary burst window.
Use offensive trinkets and racial abilities during Voidform and Power Infusion.
Cast Shadow Word: Madness if your Insanity is nearly full (35 deficit or less) or you have a Mind Devourer proc.
Cast Void Blast on cooldown whenever it is available.
Cast Tentacle Slam to refresh Vampiric Touch or if you are about to cap on charges.
Channel Void Torrent only when your damage-over-time effects are active on the target.
Cast Mind Blast as your primary generator if you do not have a Mind Devourer proc.
Cast Mind Flay: Insanity when you have the proc available.
Cast Shadow Word: Death when the target is below 20% health or to trigger Inescapable Torment while a pet is active.
Cast Shadow Word: Death to spend additional charges or when moving.
Channel Mind Flay as your filler when no other high-priority abilities are available.
